In this file, we explore the application of the local shrinkage algorithm to a model containing an asymmetric binary predictor

Loading of libraries and dataset
```{r}
library(Hmisc)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

getHdata(gusto)
gusto.dat <- gusto



gusto.dat <- gusto[which(gusto$grpl %in% c(1,2,4) & gusto$grps %in% c(5,9,10,11)),] 
n_pat <- nrow(gusto.dat)  #conta quanti pazienti hai dopo il filtro: 1214
gusto.dat$pat.id <- 1:n_pat

```

Binary predictors shrinkage

Model: height + shock where shock is a binary predictor highly asymmetric

```{r}
gusto.dat$SHO <- gusto.dat$sho 
gusto.dat$WEI <- gusto.dat$weight
gusto.dat$HEI <- gusto.dat$height

form1 <- WEI ~ HEI + SHO #model

table(gusto.dat$SHO)
```

local shrinkage
```{r}
X_ols <- model.matrix(~HEI+SHO, data=gusto.dat)
XTX <- t(X_ols)%*%X_ols

relvar_OLS <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols))  
for(i in 1:length(relvar_OLS)){
  relvar_OLS[i] <- (t(X_ols[i,])%*%solve(XTX)%*%X_ols[i,])
}

n <- nrow(X_ols)
dist_ShoHei <- (n*relvar_OLS)-1



dist_df <- data.frame(
  pat.id = gusto.dat$pat.id,
  distance = dist_ShoHei
)


Z_ols      <- X_ols[,-1] 
n          <- nrow(Z_ols)
Z_shrink   <- Z_ols
relvar_it  <- relvar_OLS
z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink)
zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar}))
X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink)

iter       <- 0
maxiter    <- 1000

dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1
diststart  <- dist
max_dist   <- (n/200) -1  #effective sample size threshold chosen for exploration : 200

while(max(dist) > max_dist & iter < maxiter){
  
  distshrink  <- dist
  distshrink[which(dist>max_dist)] <- max_dist
  
  a           <- sqrt(distshrink/dist)
  azc         <- a*zc
  Z_shrink    <- t(apply(X=azc, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar}))
  
  iter <- iter + 1
  
  X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink)
  z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink)
  zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar}))
  
  Cov        <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink)
  relvar_it  <- diag(X_shrink %*% Cov %*% t(X_shrink))
  n_eff      <- 1/relvar_it
  
  dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1
}
```


Dataframe building for visualization
```{r}
mod_OLS_base <- lm(formula = form1, data = gusto.dat) 
gusto_shrunk <- data.frame("WEI" = gusto.dat$weight) 
gusto_shrunk <- cbind(gusto_shrunk, Z_shrink) 

mod_OLS_shrunk <- lm(formula = form1, data = gusto_shrunk) 

shrinkplot <- rbind(data.frame(relvar = relvar_OLS,
                               pred = mod_OLS_base$fitted.values,
                               type = "OLS"),
                    data.frame(relvar = relvar_it,
                               pred = mod_OLS_shrunk$fitted.values,
                               type = "shrunk"))

Z_compare      <- rbind(Z_ols, Z_shrink) 
Z_compare      <- as.data.frame(Z_compare) 
Z_compare$type <- shrinkplot$type 
Z_compare$pat.id <- c(1:n, 1:n)
```

Visualization:  shock + height predictor values before and after local shrinkage
```{r}
ggplot(Z_compare, aes(x=SHO, y=HEI, color=type, fill=type, group=pat.id))+ 
       geom_point(alpha=0.8)+
       geom_line(color="grey",alpha=0.5)+
  labs(x= "Shock", y="Height") +
       theme_bw()
```
Visualization:

Predictor height before and after local shrinkage. Height is colored by the shock category value
```{r}
wide_df <- Z_compare %>%
  select(pat.id, type, HEI, SHO) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = type,
    values_from = c(HEI, SHO)
  )
      
df_sho0 <- wide_df[wide_df$SHO_OLS == 0, ] 
df_sho1 <- wide_df[wide_df$SHO_OLS == 1, ]

xrange <- range(c(df_sho0$HEI_OLS, df_sho1$HEI_OLS))
yrange <- range(c(df_sho0$HEI_shrunk, df_sho1$HEI_shrunk))

plot(df_sho0$HEI_OLS, df_sho0$HEI_shrunk,
     col="blue", pch=16,
     xlim=xrange, ylim=yrange,
     xlab="HEI OLS", ylab="HEI shrunk", main= "model: height + shock")

points(df_sho1$HEI_OLS, df_sho1$HEI_shrunk,
       col="red", pch=16)
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("shock = 0", "shock = 1"),
       col = c("blue", "red"),
       pch = 16)
```
